summary_md: **Chandan Joshi ([@chandan__dev](https://x.com/chandan__dev/status/2116071566194958387))** announces ClearRoute's open-source **runkora**, a Kubernetes control plane for running Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode with isolated sandboxes, per-agent identity, policy and budgets and no credentials inside agents (Apache 2.0); a follow-up links the docs and deploy guide ([runkora/kora](https://github.com/runkora/kora), [runkora.dev](https://runkora.dev)).
